title: Cool Breeze Citrus Spritz

diffuser.notes: Add to a diffuser with water for a refreshing, cooling room atmosphere.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spritz on linens or air.

why_it_works: Peppermint and lemon deliver an instant cooling, bright lift for hot days, while lavender softens the edge and adds a calm, grounded finish.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
